(please do not leave money in the basket). ferrybank & slieverue annual remembrance masses the annual mass of remembrance for all our deceased and especially for t he families who have been bereaved during the past year will be celebrated on the following dates :- ferrybank saturday 7th november 7.00 pm slieverue saturday 14th november 6.00 pm there will be a candle provided for each family who they wish after the mass. for further information please contact the parish office. mass of the sick and anointing of the sick the sacrament of anointing of the sick brings spiritual grace, peace, strength, comfort and healing. it can restore spiritual, emotional and physical healt h, if it is god’s will. any catholic or christian in serious illness, advancing age or preparing for surgery can avail of it. it can be repeated monthly or if an illness worsens. the priest lays his hands on the person and anoints their forehead and the palms of their hands with blessed oil offering a special prayer of healing and grace. in relation to this importan t sacrament, starting in november, the last thursday of the month in ferrybank at 10.00am and the last friday of the month at 10.00am in slieverue, a special mass of the sick including anointing will be celebrated. pride of place award we are delighted to let you know that slieverue parish community was r unner-up in the national pride of place awards announced in dublin recently. slie verue parish was nominated by kilkenny county council under the community wellbeing category which is an exceptionally difficult category to win. our parish was runner- up in this category. the judges were particularly complimentary and highlighted that slieverue isa vibrant rural community making use of key facilities including the parish hall, sli everue gaa club and slieverue community childcare. the parish community does excellent work in reaching out to all members of the community, the parish hall being a hub of activity with chair yoga, youth groups, dancing, drama, community meetings, bridge club among other activities. we are delighted with this award and congratulations to all involved in making slieverue a wonderful community in which to live. st vincent de paul - ferrybank our november monthly collection will take place next saturday and sun day the 6th & 7th november 2026. your support as always is much appreciated! visitation of the sick and housebound next friday is 6th november and fr. roderick will visit the sick and the housebound in both ferrybank & slieverue parishes. if you are already on our monthly visitation list we will be in contact with you to arrange visitation. if you have a family member who is sick or housebound and would like to receive holy communion at home please contact the parish office. please remember visitation can only take place following a request from the person themselves or a family member. ferrybank

st. canice's catholic parish in kilkenny will host a special exposition of more than 3,000 first-class relics of saints and martyrs on the feast of all saints, sunday, november 1. the public veneration will take place during and after the 11:30 a.m.
mass. the collection offers a rare opportunity to encounter tangible links to the lives of saints and marty rs throughout church history.
